::: {.home-lead}
The Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation (SCJN) publishes Mexican legal
instruments as complete texts that incorporate their reforms, and keeps, for
every instrument, the text as it read after each reform. **scjn** reads that
database through the SCJN's own JSON API (the backend of
`legislacion.scjn.gob.mx/consulta`), writes each of those texts as a dated
Markdown snapshot, and reads the five releases that publish them: federal
laws (`scjn-leyes`), regulations (`scjn-reglamentos`), guidelines
(`scjn-lineamientos`), international treaties (`scjn-tratados`) and bylaws
(`scjn-estatutos`).
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## The SCJN is not an official source of legal text

The texts are editorial: the Official Gazette of the Federation (DOF) remains
the official source of Mexican legal text. The DOF publishes a reform as a
decree that states only the amendments, so it records how a text changes; the
SCJN compiles the text that results. `fuente: scjn` in a snapshot's provenance
header means exactly that. This site and its releases hold SCJN data only:
nothing links a snapshot to the DOF note that published it, and that linking
lives outside this repository.
:::

::: {.fronts}
::: {.front}
### Five collections

Laws (`scjn-leyes`: 315 federal laws, one snapshot per reform, keyed by
`abrev`) and four collections keyed by the SCJN's identifier
(`id_ordenamiento`): regulations, guidelines, treaties and bylaws. All five
releases are published; see [Releases](pages/releases.qmd).
:::
::: {.front}
### Disk-first readers

Every reader reads the cache and raises `AssetNotCached` rather than
downloading; only `scjn download` and the `download_*_assets` functions talk
to the network.
:::
::: {.front}
### An outline that changes no text

One marker line per block that yields text; `strip_markers` returns the text
byte for byte.
:::
:::

## Quickstart

```bash
pip install scjn
scjn download --slug lfca
```

```python
from scjn import download_scjn_leyes_index, download_scjn_leyes_corpus, markdown_de_snapshot

index = download_scjn_leyes_index()           # the release's index, off the cache
corpus = download_scjn_leyes_corpus("lfca")   # one law's tarball contents, off the cache
text = markdown_de_snapshot("lfca", "<snapshot file name>")  # one reform, as Markdown
```

See [Install](pages/install.qmd) for what the package needs,
[Command line](pages/cli.qmd) and [Python](pages/python.qmd) for the two ways
to read a release, [Releases](pages/releases.qmd) for how the releases are
laid out, [Outline](pages/outline.qmd) for the marker lines and the
completeness guard, and [Crawl](pages/crawl.qmd) for the scripts that produce a
release. Extending the package itself is documented separately, on the
[developer docs](https://legistlan.github.io/scjn/dev/).
